# AItoolFit

> Task-based AI tool finder. Describe a task and get 3 AI tools that fit it, with the reason for each. Tool data (pricing, versions, plans) is updated when vendors change it, and every page shows the date it was last verified. No paid placements. Available in English, Spanish, German, Russian, Ukrainian, Hebrew, French and Portuguese.

## AI for a task

- [AI for every task](https://aitoolfit.ai/ai-for.html): all tasks with three picks each
- [Best AI for product photos](https://aitoolfit.ai/ai-for/product-photos.html): Compare Photoroom, Krea AI and Canva AI for online store photos: white backgrounds, lifestyle scenes, AI models and batch editing for whole product catalogs.
- [Best AI to make a logo](https://aitoolfit.ai/ai-for/logo.html): Need a logo for your small business or startup? Compare Looka, Canva AI and Recraft to find AI tools that generate, edit and brand your logo fast.
- [Best AI for presentations](https://aitoolfit.ai/ai-for/presentation.html): Making a presentation? See how Gamma, Canva AI, and Pitch each turn a prompt into slides, so you can pick the fastest fit for your team and deck style.
- [Best AI to generate images](https://aitoolfit.ai/ai-for/image-generation.html): Turn a text prompt into an image using Nano Banana, ChatGPT Images or Midjourney. Compare free editing, in-chat workflows and top-tier art quality.
- [Best AI to turn blog posts into videos](https://aitoolfit.ai/ai-for/blog-to-video.html): Turn blog posts into short social videos with Synthesia for avatar explainers, HeyGen for cloned-voice localization, or CapCut for fast AI-edited clips.
- [Best AI to generate videos](https://aitoolfit.ai/ai-for/video-generation.html): Turn text or a photo into video clips and ads. See why Kling AI, Google Veo and Higgsfield fit this task, from cinematic shots to multi-model ad workflows.
- [Best AI to edit podcasts and add subtitles](https://aitoolfit.ai/ai-for/podcast-editing.html): Edit a podcast and add subtitles using AI. Descript edits by transcript, Adobe Podcast cleans up audio, and CapCut adds captions and exports video fast.
- [Best AI for voiceovers](https://aitoolfit.ai/ai-for/voiceover.html): Compare ElevenLabs, Murf AI and Speechify for adding natural AI voiceover to narration, promo and explainer videos, and see which fits your workflow.
- [Best AI for meeting notes](https://aitoolfit.ai/ai-for/meeting-notes.html): Need to transcribe a meeting and pull out key points and action items? Compare Otter.ai, Granola and Fireflies.ai to find the best fit for your team.
- [Best AI for SEO](https://aitoolfit.ai/ai-for/seo.html): Grow your site in Google search and AI answers with Semrush, Surfer SEO and Frase — tools for SEO data, content scoring and AI visibility tracking.

## Catalog and comparisons
